SELECT ts_t, ts_doy, ts_hour, wtmp_c, ROUND(wtmp_c * 1.8 + 32, 1) as wtmp_f
FROM pier
ORDER BY ts_t DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT fish_date_doy, COUNT(*) as n_trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt, ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as avg_yt_per_trip
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy >= 91 AND fish_date_doy <= 121
GROUP BY fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC

SELECT fish_date_doy, COUNT(*) as n_trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt, ROUND(SUM(yt) / COUNT(*), 2) as avg_yt_per_trip
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy >= 287 AND fish_date_doy <= 297
GROUP BY fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_doy

SELECT 
  'Water Temp Now' as metric,
  ROUND(wtmp_c * 9/5 + 32, 1) as value_f
FROM pier
WHERE ts_doy >= 119
ORDER BY ts_t DESC
LIMIT 1
